# Vendored: canonical ProofArtifact schema v1

`proof-artifact.schema.v1.json` is a **verbatim, sovereign-vendored copy** of the
estate-canonical ProofArtifact schema whose authoritative home is:

- repo: `SocioProphet/socioprophet-standards-storage`
- path: `schemas/proof-artifact/proof-artifact.schema.v1.json`
- `$id`: `https://schemas.socioprophet.ai/proof-artifact/v1.json`

It is vendored (not fetched from a CDN at runtime) so SCOPE-D's offline AJV
validators can resolve the `$ref` from `config/schemas/proof-artifact.schema.json`
into the canonical `epistemicLevel` enum. See standards-storage#97 (remediation R2).

Do NOT edit this file locally. To change the canonical, update it upstream in
standards-storage and re-vendor the exact bytes.
